# Writing migrations

## Skeleton (as generated by `add`)

```php
<?php

namespace Sprint\Migration;

class Version20260720120000 extends Version
{
    protected $author = '';
    protected $description = 'Add news iblock';
    protected $moduleVersion = '5.15.1';

    public function up()
    {
        $helper = $this->getHelperManager();
    }

    public function down()
    {
    }
}
```

The base `down()` throws "write down code": keep an explicit `down()`, empty with a comment when rollback is impossible.

## Result contract

| In `up`/`down` | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| no return / `true` | Success |
| `return false` | Failure ("migration return false"); status unchanged |
| throw `HelperException` / `MigrationException` | Failure with message |
| legacy API left `$APPLICATION->GetException()` | Failure with that message |
| `$this->restart()` / `restart*()` helpers | Pause and continue in the next iteration |

Log with `$this->outSuccess()`, `outError()`, `outWarning()`, `outInfo()` (sprintf formats: pass dynamic text as `('%s', $text)`) and `outProgress(string $msg, int $val, int $total)`.

## Idempotent helpers

```php
public function up()
{
    $helper = $this->getHelperManager();

    $helper->Iblock()->saveIblockType([
        'ID' => 'content',
        'LANG' => ['ru' => ['NAME' => 'Контент', 'SECTION_NAME' => 'Разделы', 'ELEMENT_NAME' => 'Элементы']],
    ]);
    $iblockId = $helper->Iblock()->saveIblock([
        'NAME' => 'Новости',
        'CODE' => 'content_news',
        'LID' => ['s1'],
        'IBLOCK_TYPE_ID' => 'content',
    ]);
    $helper->Iblock()->saveProperty($iblockId, ['NAME' => 'Ссылка', 'CODE' => 'LINK']);
}

public function down()
{
    $this->getHelperManager()->Iblock()->deleteIblockIfExists('content_news', 'content');
}
```

Naming rules of helpers: `rules/helpers-builders.md`.

## Dependencies

```php
$this->checkRequiredVersions(['Version20260101120000', OtherMigration::class]); // throws if not installed
```

The `$requiredVersions` property is deprecated.

## Long migrations (restartable)

Each `restart*` call processes a step, saves its params and throws `RestartException`; CLI and admin call `up()` again from the top. Code before the `restart*` call runs again on every iteration.

- `restartOnce($name, fn)` runs once and caches the return value (serialized, no objects).
- `restartWhile($name, fn(int $index): int)`: return the next index, `0` = done.
- `restartIterator($name, array $list, fn($item, $index))`: one item per iteration, `$list` must be a 0..n list. Fine for dozens of items, too slow for thousands.

```php
public function up()
{
    $ids = $this->restartOnce('ids', fn() => $this->collectIds()); // int[]
    $this->restartWhile('batch', function (int $offset) use ($ids): int {
        $chunk = array_slice($ids, $offset, 200);
        foreach ($chunk as $id) {
            // process one row
        }
        $this->outProgress('Rows', $offset + count($chunk), count($ids));

        return $chunk ? $offset + count($chunk) : 0;
    });
}
```

## Exchange files

Builders with data (`IblockElementsBuilder`, `HlblockElementsBuilder`, …) write XML to `{exchange_dir}/{VersionName}_files/`; access from code with `$this->getExchangeManager()`. Commit that dir with the version. No personal data or secrets in it.

## Hand-written data migrations

```php
public function up()
{
    if (!\Bitrix\Main\Loader::includeModule('vendor.module')) {
        $this->outError('vendor.module is not installed');
        return false;
    }
    $result = \Vendor\Module\Model\ItemTable::add(['CODE' => 'promo', 'TITLE' => 'Promo']);
    if (!$result->isSuccess()) {
        $this->outError('%s', implode('; ', $result->getErrorMessages()));
        return false;
    }
}
```

- Prefer D7 ORM and services; match rows by business key so a rerun is safe.
- Raw SQL only when ORM/helpers can't express it, escaped via `SqlHelper` (`bitrix-database`).
- Never: secrets, absolute paths of one machine, edits to `/bitrix/`, random seeds, runtime business logic.
- One-way data fixes get an empty `down()` with a reason; no destructive `down()` "for symmetry".
